decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is peripheral to the firm's technology focus, but it costs little to keep on the market and its consumer demand is still uncertain after one year, so the option is held a while longer.
The modular plant extensions build on the core waste-to-energy offer, cost little to list, and leave uncertainty about deployment unresolved, so keeping the option open is worthwhile.
As a flagship with its own page, the waste oil to energy plant is central to the firm's direction, and nothing yet shows its value is unlikely to be realized.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is a flagship in an emerging market where uncertainty is still high, so the option justifies continued commitment despite having only a brief mention on the website.
